faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 19 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: The terrifying history of Summerwind, a haunted Wisconsin mansion destroyed by fire.
kurzfassung: In 1969, a large family buys the abandoned Summerwind mansion in Wisconsin, only to experience intense paranormal activity and a drastic psychological decline in the husband. Years later, relatives attempt to renovate the property and uncover local legends tied to an 18th-century land grant. The decaying structure ultimately burns down after being struck by lightning in 1988.
stichpunkte: Ginger and Arnold Hinshaw purchase the vacant Summerwind mansion in 1969 to accommodate their large family.
Locals refuse to work on the property due to its reputation as one of Wisconsin's most haunted houses.
Arnold's personality changes dramatically for the worse, culminating in his hospitalization after months of erratic behavior.
Ginger and her children flee the house with the help of her father, leading to a divorce.
Ginger's father Raymond and brother Carl later repurchase the property to turn it into an inn.
Carl experiences terrifying apparitions and gunshot noises similar to an event reported by the original owner in 1916.
Hypnosis sessions with Raymond and Carl reveal a vision of a hidden land grant belonging to explorer Jonathan Carver.
After failing to find the document, Raymond sells the house, which eventually burns down in 1988 after being struck by lightning.

clips.hook: Workers wouldn't even drive up the driveway
clips.text: Contractors refused to enter the property or even drive their vehicles up the driveway once they learned the address.
The grandfather admitted he listened to accounts of the haunting purely through a lens of skepticism.

clips.hook: Firing a pistol at an apparition
clips.text: The original owner grabbed a gun from a drawer and fired two shots straight through a basement door at a phantom figure.

clips.hook: Struck by lightning and burned to the ground
clips.text: Multiple lightning strikes ultimately caused the decaying structure to catch fire and burn completely.

beschreibung:
When Ginger Hinshaw first saw Summerwind in the summer of 1969, she knew she had to have the house. Recently remarried and looking for a new home for her large family, she convinced her husband, Arnold, to buy the house and the two planned to renovate the place together, since all of their resources were tied up in the house. Ginger couldn’t believe her luck, but very soon after moving in, Ginger’s luck seemed to have run out.
When the Hinshaws moved into Summerwind, they were the picture of a happy American family. But just a few months later, Arnold’s personality had changed entirely, as the house began to possess him and take him over completely. In time, the marriage fell apart and the family fled the house, but that was only the beginning.
